not_offered: Switching on: Meta's API here accepts only PAUSED, so you turn the campaign on in Ads Manager after the date fix.
Budget: $1.00 a day is at the floor; no change unless you want one.
Objective: changing Engagement to Traffic needs a new campaign.
after_launch: Day 1: the ad leaves review and starts spending; no delivery error on the ad set.
Days 2-3: post engagements are recorded; spend paces near $1 a day.
Day 7: cost per post engagement, and whether comments came in (the aim of this test). Avoid big edits before then.
go_deeper: Before any conversion campaign: meta-pixel-capi-health-check, if installed (no pixel on this account).
For site visits instead of comments: facebook-ads-campaign-structure, if installed.
